report_kind: Derived summary of previously recorded local experiments
scope: Source-level retrieval and application-response measurements; no investment-return or factual-accuracy evaluation.

provenance.latency_source_verification_note: All 23 source and 4 corpus fingerprints match reference-commit bytes directly or after LF-to-CRLF conversion. Existing UTF-8 BOMs are preserved.
provenance.initial_live_source_version: Not pinned by the initial live log; no source manifest is present in that report.
provenance.duplicate_excluded: latency_profile(1).json is byte-identical to latency_profile.json and is counted once.
omitted_fields: Market-price values and full allocation payloads

initial_live_evaluation.protocol: Sequential run, no warm-up, existing 10 cases. Final-answer latency includes price fetching, scoring, RAG retrieval, and Gemini generation. API failures are excluded from success latency and reported separately.
initial_live_evaluation.citation_coverage_note: Requires claim-level annotation and evidence checking; reference-list presence is not citation coverage.

retrieval.note: @1 and @3 use prefixes of the existing top-5 results. Source labels do not establish passage-level answer correctness.

answers.note: Keyword/disclaimer checks are not factual accuracy. Review saved answers and references to annotate citation coverage.

latency_experiments.protocol: Sequential paired trials; baseline/variant order alternates. No answer caching. Market-cache TTL includes misses and expires normally. Compare only pairs with all 5 candidates and identical observed price data plus base prompt inputs. No fixed price snapshot is imposed; changing data is detected and excluded from matched comparisons. First-use and warm requests are recorded separately.
latency_experiments.quality_note: Keyword/disclaimer checks and structured allocation checks do not verify factual accuracy, citation coverage, or numbers in generated prose. Review answers manually before making quality-preservation claims.
latency_experiments.latency_note: End-to-end timing includes data fetching, scoring, retrieval, chain setup, generation, and formatting; one-time index creation and imports are excluded. No first-token/streaming measurement.
